title: A Primer of the Returning Stick
summary: Teaches grip and stance and level cast of the returning stick to a student with no qi and no training.

title: Handbook of the Curved Throwing Stick
summary: Drills short casts at a post for students who have only begun to toughen the skin of the hand.

title: The Boomerang Thrower's Plain Book
summary: Sets out the hip turn and loaded shoulder cast for students building muscle to power the stick.

title: Wrist and Release Workbook for the Boomerang
summary: Trains the tendon snap of the wrist and the clean release that gives the stick its spin.

title: Field Rules for the Hunting Boomerang
summary: Teaches the heavy flat-flying hunting stick and its low stalking casts to students with hardened bone.

title: Primer of the Qi Light Boomerang
summary: Shows a newly awakened student how a thin thread of qi quickens the spin and steadies the return.

title: Book of the Easy Returning Arc
summary: Teaches a circulating student to bend the stick through a wide loop and to take it home again.

title: Treatise on Wing Shaped Throwing Wood
summary: Explains how the lift of each wing arm is read and spent by a student who already circulates qi.

title: Drills for the Curved Wing at Distance
summary: Drills the far cast and the long return so a student learns to send the stick out and bring it back.

title: The Catching Hand Canon
summary: Trains the receiving hand to meet a returning stick with soft qi so it is never dropped or fumbled.
